tasks.label: install gh locally
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
asset_url=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/cli/cli/releases/latest') as response:
    data = json.load(response)
for asset in data['assets']:
    name = asset['name']
    if '_macOS_arm64.tar.gz' in name:
        print(asset['browser_download_url'])
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('No macOS arm64 gh asset found')
PY
)
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "$asset_url" -o "$tmpdir/gh.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$tmpdir/gh.tar.gz" -C "$tmpdir"
gh_bin=$(find "$tmpdir" -path '*/bin/gh' -type f | head -n 1)
cp "$gh_bin" "$HOME/.local/bin/gh"
chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/gh"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
gh --version

tasks.label: install gh arm64 zip
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
command -v unzip >/dev/null
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
asset_url=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/cli/cli/releases/latest') as response:
    data = json.load(response)
for asset in data['assets']:
    if asset['name'].endswith('_macOS_arm64.zip'):
        print(asset['browser_download_url'])
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('No macOS arm64 gh asset found')
PY
)
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "$asset_url" -o "$tmpdir/gh.zip"
unzip -q "$tmpdir/gh.zip" -d "$tmpdir"
gh_bin=$(find "$tmpdir" -path '*/bin/gh' -type f | head -n 1)
cp "$gh_bin" "$HOME/.local/bin/gh"
chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/gh"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
gh --version

direct github models auth probe
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s courseforge.COURSEFORGE_GITHUB_TOKEN -w)
if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo "missing token"; exit 1; fi
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/courseforge-github-models-probe.json -w "%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "https://models.github.ai/inference/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
  -d '{"model":"openai/gpt-4.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Respond with ok"}],"max_tokens":4,"temperature":0}')
echo "http=$HTTP_CODE"
cat /tmp/courseforge-github-models-probe.json

tasks.label: probe github models candidates
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s courseforge.COURSEFORGE_GITHUB_TOKEN -w)
for model in openai/gpt-4.1 openai/gpt-4.1-mini openai/gpt-4o openai/gpt-4o-mini; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/courseforge-model-probe.json -w "%{http_code}" \
    -X POST "https://models.github.ai/inference/chat/completions" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
    -d "{\"model\":\"$model\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Respond with ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":4,\"temperature\":0}")
  printf "%s => http=%s\n" "$model" "$code"
  cat /tmp/courseforge-model-probe.json
  echo
 done
